title: Answer: no account of life, and biological conditions guide where to look for consciousness

statements.text: The theorem takes no position on what life is. Biology enters as a guide: theories that identify the necessary biological conditions for consciousness help find the physical systems whose present state counts. On a state-based theory, natural selection could favor neural systems that produce a conscious physical configuration because of its effects on later neural activity.
statements.scope: the no-go theorem, version 1 of the preprint
